ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity dark pigmentation (approx. 85-90%) with localized high-intensity white patches (approx. 10-15%) primarily on the lower interior and upper distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white hook-shaped blob located at the interior base of the left lobe; dense white clusters on the upper exterior tip of the left lobe; scattered white mottling along the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge shows fine-grained, high-frequency serrations. Left lobe trailing edge displays macro-level irregular indentations, specifically a significant jagged notch on the upper distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the outer margins sweeping upwards and outwards from the peduncle base.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters concentrated on the superior tip of the left lobe and inner margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions visible on the dark field of the lower left lobe, oriented horizontally/sub-parallel to the water surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular indentation and missing tissue on the distal tip of the left lobe; multiple white rake-mark-like scars on the lower left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique hook-shaped white pigmentation mark on the inner left lobe near the fluke-peduncle junction.
